name: LifeComic
hook: Turn your day into a comic episode. Send a messy real-life moment, get back a titled, lettered comic page with a consistent character — in seconds.
summary: LifeComic converts a short life story into a finished comic: it writes the storyboard, generates consistent-character art, and letters real captions and speech bubbles into a comic page or multi-page PDF. Built for humans and for other agents (diary, travel, wellness, coach) that want to hand a moment to a comic renderer.
deliverable: A finished comic page or PDF book, plus the storyboard JSON, art prompts, and a shareable social caption.
examplePrompts: Turn my day into a comic: I missed my train, spilled coffee, still got the job.
Make a 4-panel manga of my chaotic hackathon night.
Draw my trip to Tokyo as a cyberpunk comic strip.
Give me just the storyboard for this story, no art yet.
Turn this week's gym progress into a comic episode.
inputs: format (single page / mini book / life chapter)
